title: Programmatic probe harness for segmented shadow validation and automatic quarantine
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Build a lightweight, programmatic probe harness that runs segmented golden prompt validations against shadow traffic and A/B segments, produces per-cohort scorecards, and triggers automated quarantine/rollback actions when predefined multi-signal criteria are met. The harness should operate without adding latency to production paths (shadow-only), integrate with the Console scorecard dashboard, and emit telemetry to the existing eval and rollout pipelines.
motivation: We frequently observe subtle quality regressions that only manifest for specific customer cohorts or prompt distributions. Current canary checks are coarse-grained and miss cohort-specific degradations. A programmable shadow probe that exercises weighted golden prompts for segments and ties into an automated quarantine flow will reduce regression windows and manual triage effort.
technical_design: The harness will accept a segmentation key (customer_id, product_feature, language) and a weighted golden probe set per segment. For each incoming request in shadow mode, the harness will probabilistically sample a subset of probes based on a small reservoir sampler. Samples are evaluated by the candidate model and the baseline model to produce differential metrics (sequence-level score, token-level divergence, semantic-similarity embedding delta, entropy delta). Each metric is time-windowed (1m, 5m, 1h) and stored in the eval time-series service. A scoring function computes a composite risk score using configurable weights and staleness penalty for golden prompts older than a configured TTL. When the composite score crosses the quarantine threshold and corroborating signals (increased error-rate, latency spike, and customer-scope amplification) are present, the orchestrator emits a quarantine event to the rollout controller which can reduce traffic or flip to fallback. Integration points: Console scorecards (for visualizing per-segment heatmaps), rollout controller API (for triggering quarantines), eval time-series (for metrics), and audit log for compliance. Implementation will be in two parts: a lightweight agent in the runtime for request duplication and sampling, and an orchestration microservice for scoring, thresholds, and outbound actions.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Shadow probe harness runs against production shadow traffic for three segments (enterprise-us, self-serve-eu, mobile-sdk) without adding observable latency to production requests.
2) Per-segment scorecards appear in Console with 1m/5m/1h aggregations and can be filtered by probe set.
3) Composite risk score computed and visible, with an RPC that can emit a quarantine event to the rollout controller.
4) When quarantine is triggered in a staging run, rollout controller reduces candidate model traffic by configured fraction and records audit event.
5) Playbook for investigating false positives is documented and validated with on-call runbook drill.
6) Unit and integration tests cover sampler, metrics emission, scoring, and quarantine API interactions.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal staging - enable on internal traffic only with two segments and synthetic golden sets. Phase 2: Shadow small self-serve cohort (1% traffic) and verify scorecard telemetry for 48 hours. Phase 3: Enable on three public segments (enterprise-us, self-serve-eu, mobile-sdk) at 0.5% shadow sampling for 7 days. Phase 4: Turn on automated quarantine in canary-only mode (no automatic rollback to production) for 14 days and tune thresholds. Phase 5: Enable full quarantine actions (traffic cutback/fallback) behind feature flag and monitor for 28 days before defaulting to enabled for runtime-1.30.
monitoring_signals: Composite risk score, per-probe failure rate, cross-model BLEU/ROUGE deltas, embedding cosine drift, token-level KL divergence, on-path error rate, request latency percentiles, per-segment amplification (requests affected / segment size). Each signal should have baseline alarms and an aggregated hysteresis rule to avoid flapping.
playbook: If quarantine fires: 1) Triage via Console scorecard -> identify top 10 probes contributing to risk. 2) Check PR history and recent model changes for candidate. 3) Re-run golden probes in offline harness against candidate and baseline locally. 4) If confirmed, keep candidate quarantined and open rollback PR; notify stakeholders. 5) If false positive, escalate to SRE and adjust threshold or augment golden set. Record decision in audit log.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Golden-set staleness causing false alarms. Mitigation: staleness penalty and automated golden refresh recommendation service. Risk: overfitting to golden prompts and gaming. Mitigation: reservoir sampling of external user prompts for validation and periodic adversarialization. Risk: noisy small cohorts leading to churn. Mitigation: minimum-sample floor and amplification normalization.

updates: 2026-03-12: Spike complete for reservoir sampler prototype. Initial microbench shows <0.2ms median overhead for shadow duplication on p99 path.
2026-03-13: Scoring prototype validated against historical rollout where a cohort-specific regression occurred; composite risk score rose above threshold during the incident window.
2026-03-14: Feature flag gate added; staging run scheduled for 2026-03-20. Added console tickets for scorecard visualization.
notes: Keep golden probes immutable per-release and store provenance tags. Consider a later follow-up to add per-customer adaptive thresholds based on historical noise profiles.
